name: Kharg Island
description: Handles ~90% of Iran's oil exports. Single most critical Iranian energy chokepoint.

name: Ras Laffan Industrial City
description: World's largest LNG export facility and primary global helium source. North Field gas operations.

name: Abqaiq Processing Facility
description: World's largest oil processing facility. Processes ~7 mb/d. Hit by drones in 2019.

name: Ghawar Oil Field
description: World's largest oil field. ~3.8 mb/d production.

name: Fujairah Oil Terminal
description: Major oil storage and bunkering hub. Bypass route for Strait of Hormuz via pipeline.

name: Strait of Hormuz
description: Critical chokepoint: ~21% of global oil passes through. IRGC now developing vetting/approval system for transit.

name: Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant
description: Iran's only operational nuclear power plant. Strikes nearby raise contamination risk.

name: Bandar Abbas Refinery
description: Major Iranian refinery near Strait of Hormuz. Strategic target.

name: Mina al-Ahmadi Refinery
description: Kuwait's largest refinery. Struck by Iranian missiles on March 20.

name: Ras Tanura Terminal
description: World's largest offshore oil loading facility. ~6.5 mb/d capacity.
